summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed and a static render_speed; track() gained show_speed (default True); Progress.track infers total as Optional[float] and no longer raises for unsized iterables. Added a CHANGELOG line and test_task_progress_column_speed, and removed the two ValueError assertions in tests/test_progress.py. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, per instructions, so they remain unverified.
